name: Stock Message For WooCommerce
author: Poodle Plugins

sections.description:
Stock Message For WooCommerce adds a powerful notification system to your WooCommerce store that lets customers sign up for back-in-stock alerts. When products return to stock, subscribed customers automatically receive customized email notifications.

Key features:

  • Customizable “Notify Me” buttons with full styling controls
  • Email verification system for subscriber validation
  • reCAPTCHA integration (v2/v3) for form security
  • Support for simple, variable and grouped products
  • Automated back-in-stock email notifications
  • Subscriber management dashboard with search and filtering
  • Customizable email templates with product variables
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stock-message-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Use the Settings -> Stock Message Settings screen to configure the notification emails.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes, the plugin fully supports simple, variable and grouped products in WooCommerce.

How do customers sign up for notifications?

When a product is out of stock, customers see a customizable “Notify Me” button. They enter their email address and receive an optional verification email before being added to the notification list.

When are notification emails sent?

Emails are sent automatically when a product’s stock status changes from “out of stock” to “in stock”. The system monitors both manual stock updates and WooCommerce inventory changes.
